bellgrave.description: A heavily fortified frontier city of the militarised Dominion, where political tension and sanctioned Duelist power are openly visible.
bellgrave.name: Bellgrave

caer_lumen.description: The great archive city of the scholarly Republic — home to one of the world's largest surviving collections of Crest records, much of it restricted.
caer_lumen.name: Caer Lumen

evershade.description: An ancient settlement outside the modern power blocs, preserving Crest traditions that predate the kingdoms. Important later.
evershade.name: Evershade

first_vault.description: A late-game ancient site tied to the fragmentation of Eidros. A long-term narrative destination — not used in the prototype.
first_vault.name: The First Vault

greymere.description: The protagonist's starting town — a peaceful, slightly isolated border settlement where ordinary life continues over an ancient sealed Crest site.
greymere.name: Greymere

hollow_court.description: An ancient ruined duelling site beneath Greymere. Publicly an empty historical ruin; in truth a sealed Crest site holding dormant divine fragments and forbidden records. The opening incident happens here.
hollow_court.name: The Hollow Court

solharbor.description: A wealthy maritime trade city: political meetings, smugglers, illegal Crest markets, and factions negotiating over all of it.
solharbor.name: Solharbor

veyrhold.description: A major Avelainian city housing one of the recognised Duelist trial institutions. Aren is brought here after becoming Crestbound.
veyrhold.name: Veyrhold
